title: Bert Kelly's orchestra at the Sherman House
summary: Lopez clarifies that Kelly led the Sherman House orchestra, played banjo, and later ran his own nightclub.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Was that Bert Kelly? Was that the stables that he had then? Yeah, that's the stables.
Only I didn't play the stables. Kelly had the orchestra at the Sherman House.
Oh, he actually was a musician.
Oh, yeah. Oh, he played a beautiful banjo.
Yeah, because I thought maybe he was mostly just a promoter. No, no, no. A nightclub, wasn't he?
No, no, no. Afterwards, he got his own nightclub, see?
